title: descurainia antarctica
intro: Descurainia antarctica, commonly known as the Antarctic plant or more commonly referred to as  Antarctic plant, is a flowering plant species of the mustard family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Descurainia antarctica include anti-arthritic, anti-allergic, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins.
